_about: Customer-facing wording for proposal lines. Lifetime warranty goes ONLY on full installs (see rules.md). Keep lines short: no 'haul away debris' style filler.

warranty.lifetime: Covered by the Ridgeline Home Exteriors Lifetime Workmanship Warranty (see warranty terms).
warranty.paint: One coat applied in two passes. Paint workmanship covers missed coverage found within the first year.
warranty.manufacturer: Manufacturer warranty from {maker}; registering it is the customer's responsibility.{links} Manufacturer defects aren't covered by our workmanship warranty, and labor is charged on manufacturer-defect repairs.
warranty.stuccoColorMatch: Stucco repairs can't be perfectly color-matched to the existing wall.
warranty.manufacturerNoRegistration: Manufacturer warranty from {maker}. No registration is needed; in the event of a warranty claim, just reach out to us for any documentation needed from us.{links} Manufacturer defects aren't covered by our workmanship warranty, and labor is charged on manufacturer-defect repairs.

manufacturers._about: Links shown on proposal lines come ONLY from the manufacturer's own website. 'verified' is set to true once Sean has confirmed the maker's process and links. 'registration': false uses warranty.manufacturerNoRegistration (customer contacts RHX for documentation) instead of the standard 'registering it is the customer's responsibility' sentence. No link is better than a guessed one.

lp._process: No homeowner registration. For a claim LP needs a letter or invoice from RHX showing the install date and our GC license number; the customer contacts RHX for it.

hardie._process: No homeowner registration. For a claim the customer needs our invoice (which should show our GC license number); they contact RHX if they need it.
